final: WITH group_counts AS (SELECT o.account_id, d.A3 AS region_name, COUNT(*) AS group_count FROM "order" AS o JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3), overall AS (SELECT AVG(group_count) AS overall_average FROM group_counts), differences AS (SELECT g.account_id, g.region_name, g.group_count, g.group_count - v.overall_average AS difference FROM group_counts AS g CROSS JOIN overall AS v WHERE v.overall_average IS NOT NULL), regional AS (SELECT region_name, AVG(difference) AS regional_average FROM differences GROUP BY region_name) SELECT x.account_id, x.region_name, x.group_count, x.difference, x.difference - r.regional_average AS final_difference FROM differences AS x JOIN regional AS r ON x.region_name = r.region_name COLLATE BINARY WHERE x.difference > r.regional_average ORDER BY final_difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
